PART III – LANDSPART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of land depicted in below names and extents, morefully described in the Advance Tracing No. Aa/NPC/2018/441H dated 21.08.2018, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Eerikewa and Millawewa in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 306 - Helambagaswewa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Nuwaragam Palatha Central in Anuradhapura District of North Central Province and bounded as follows:
